hypotheses.statement: The original isValidName function only checked that the input is a string with length > 0, allowing strings consisting solely of whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, newlines) to pass validation. The requirement is that a name must contain at least one non-whitespace character.
hypotheses.why_patch_addresses_it: The patch adds .trim() before checking length, which removes leading and trailing whitespace. If the string becomes empty after trimming (i.e., it contained only whitespace), the length check fails, correctly rejecting such inputs.

rounds.tests_source: import { isValidName } from '@entry' ; import { test, expect } from '@patchwitness/harness' ; test('rejects two spaces', () => { const input = '  ' ; expect(isValidName(input)).toBe(false) ; }) ; test('rejects tab character', () => { const tab = String.fromCharCode(9) ; expect(isValidName(tab)).toBe(false) ; }) ; test('rejects newline character', () => { const nl = String.fromCharCode(10) ; expect(isValidName(nl)).toBe(false) ; }) ; test('rejects mixed whitespace space-tab', () => { const mixed = ' ' + String.fromCharCode(9) ; expect(isValidName(mixed)).toBe(false) ; }) ; test('rejects empty string', () => { expect(isValidName('')).toBe(false) ; }) ; test('accepts string with surrounding whitespace but inner non-whitespace', () => { expect(isValidName('  hello  ')).toBe(true) ; expect(isValidName(String.fromCharCode(9) + 'world' + String.fromCharCode(10))).toBe(true) ; }) ; test('rejects non-string number', () => { expect(isValidName(0)).toBe(false) ; expect(isValidName(42)).toBe(false) ; }) ; test('rejects non-string null', () => { expect(isValidName(null)).toBe(false) ; }) ; test('rejects non-string undefined', () => { expect(isValidName(undefined)).toBe(false) ; }) ; test('rejects non-string object', () => { expect(isValidName({})).toBe(false) ; expect(isValidName([])).toBe(false) ; }) ;

hypotheses.statement: The validation only checks that the input is a string with length > 0, so any whitespace-only string (spaces, tabs, newlines) passes because its length is non-zero.
hypotheses.why_patch_addresses_it: The patch replaces the length check with a check that removes all space characters (' ') and then verifies the remaining length > 0, which rejects strings consisting solely of spaces.

hypotheses.statement: The patch only removes the space character (U+0020) via split(' ').join(''), leaving other whitespace characters (tab, newline, carriage return, form feed, vertical tab) untouched, so strings composed solely of those characters will still pass validation.
hypotheses.why_patch_addresses_it: The patch attempts to reject whitespace-only names by stripping spaces, but it does not account for the full set of Unicode whitespace characters, so the fix is incomplete.

hypotheses.statement: The original code already rejects non-string inputs via typeof name === 'string'; the patch preserves this check, so non-string inputs remain correctly rejected. However, the patch does not improve handling of non-string edge cases (e.g., null, undefined, objects) beyond the existing guard.
hypotheses.why_patch_addresses_it: The patch keeps the typeof guard unchanged, so non-string rejection continues to work as before. The root cause of the reported bug (whitespace-only strings) is unrelated to non-string handling, but the patch does not regress it.

rounds.tests_source: import { isValidName } from '@entry' ; import { test, expect } from '@patchwitness/harness' ; const sp = String.fromCharCode(32) ; const tab = String.fromCharCode(9) ; const lf = String.fromCharCode(10) ; const cr = String.fromCharCode(13) ; const ff = String.fromCharCode(12) ; const vt = String.fromCharCode(11) ; test('empty string returns false', () => { expect(isValidName('')).toBe(false) }) ; test('two spaces returns false', () => { expect(isValidName(sp + sp)).toBe(false) }) ; test('tab only returns false', () => { expect(isValidName(tab)).toBe(false) }) ; test('newline only returns false', () => { expect(isValidName(lf)).toBe(false) }) ; test('carriage return only returns false', () => { expect(isValidName(cr)).toBe(false) }) ; test('form feed only returns false', () => { expect(isValidName(ff)).toBe(false) }) ; test('vertical tab only returns false', () => { expect(isValidName(vt)).toBe(false) }) ; test('space + tab returns false', () => { expect(isValidName(sp + tab)).toBe(false) }) ; test('tab + newline returns false', () => { expect(isValidName(tab + lf)).toBe(false) }) ; test('space + tab + newline returns false', () => { expect(isValidName(sp + tab + lf)).toBe(false) }) ; test('null returns false', () => { expect(isValidName(null)).toBe(false) }) ; test('undefined returns false', () => { expect(isValidName(undefined)).toBe(false) }) ; test('number zero returns false', () => { expect(isValidName(0)).toBe(false) }) ; test('number positive returns false', () => { expect(isValidName(42)).toBe(false) }) ; test('object returns false', () => { expect(isValidName({})).toBe(false) }) ; test('array returns false', () => { expect(isValidName([])).toBe(false) }) ; test('boolean true returns false', () => { expect(isValidName(true)).toBe(false) }) ; test('boolean false returns false', () => { expect(isValidName(false)).toBe(false) }) ; test('valid name returns true', () => { expect(isValidName('Alice')).toBe(true) }) ; test('name with leading space returns true', () => { expect(isValidName(sp + 'Alice')).toBe(true) }) ; test('name with trailing space returns true', () => { expect(isValidName('Alice' + sp)).toBe(true) }) ; test('name with surrounding spaces returns true', () => { expect(isValidName(sp + 'Alice' + sp)).toBe(true) }) ; test('name with internal space returns true', () => { expect(isValidName('Bob Smith')).toBe(true) }) ; test('name with internal tab returns true', () => { expect(isValidName('Bob' + tab + 'Smith')).toBe(true) }) ; test('name with internal newline returns true', () => { expect(isValidName('Bob' + lf + 'Smith')).toBe(true) }) ; test('name with mixed whitespace and letters returns true', () => { expect(isValidName(sp + 'Jo' + tab + 'hn' + lf)).toBe(true) })
rationale: Tests cover empty string, various whitespace-only strings (spaces, tabs, newlines, carriage return, form feed, vertical tab, and combinations) to ensure they are rejected.
Tests verify that strings containing at least one non-whitespace character pass, including leading/trailing/internal whitespace.
Tests confirm non-string inputs (null, undefined, numbers, objects, arrays, booleans) are rejected.
These assertions align with the specification that a valid name must contain at least one non-whitespace character.
